excerpt: Loom records your screen and camera and shares the video as a link. Now part of Atlassian after a roughly $975 million deal. Pricing, who it suits and alternatives.
content:
Loom is a tool for recording short videos of your screen, your camera or both, then sharing them instantly as a link. Instead of booking a meeting, you record a walkthrough of a bug, a design review or a status update, and colleagues watch it when they have time, leaving comments and emoji reactions on the video. It works through a browser extension, desktop apps and mobile apps.

Loom was founded in 2015 in San Francisco by Joe Thomas, Vinay Hiremath and Shahed Khan. In October 2023 Atlassian, the company behind Jira and Confluence, agreed to buy it, and on 30 November 2023 Atlassian announced it had completed the acquisition. The price was about $975 million, according to Loom's legal advisers Wilson Sonsini. At the time Atlassian said Loom's business users were recording almost 5 million videos a month.

Loom carries on as its own product while being connected into Atlassian's other tools, so a recording can sit inside a Jira ticket or a Confluence page. The Business + AI plan adds Loom's AI features on top of the Business plan.

There is a free Starter plan with limits on the number of videos and the length of screen recordings, and paid plans charged per user. Loom says annual billing saves up to 17%.

We have not used Loom for this page. It brings together Loom's own website and pricing page and reporting from the outlets linked under Sources, and says where each fact comes from.

profile.platform: Chrome extension, macOS, Windows, iOS and Android
profile.summary_short: Screen and camera recorder for sharing quick work videos as links

gallery.alt: Loom promotional image reading 'Better communication with a click', with a calendar and a recording bubble showing a woman's face and a 0:04 timer

use_cases: Walking a colleague through a bug or a pull request
Design and document reviews without a meeting
Customer support answers and onboarding videos
Weekly status updates for distributed teams

fit: remote teams that want fewer meetings and more asynchronous updates
teams already on Jira or Confluence, where Loom videos fit in natively
support and sales teams that explain things better on video than in text
not_fit: anyone making polished, edited marketing videos: Loom is built for quick recordings
heavy users on the free plan, which caps videos and screen-recording length

pricing.intro: Prices from Loom's pricing page, in US dollars per user per month. The page says annual billing saves up to 17% but did not label which billing period the listed figures use.

plans.name: Starter
plans.detail: Up to 25 videos per person, 5-minute screen recordings, up to 50 members, up to 720p

plans.name: Business
plans.detail: Unlimited videos and recording length, up to 4K

plans.name: Business + AI
plans.detail: Business plus Loom AI features; 14-day free trial

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.detail: Adds a 99.95% uptime SLA and enterprise controls

alternatives.intro: Other ways to record and share work videos.

items.name: Vidyard
items.difference: Aimed at sales prospecting, with video tracking tied to CRMs.

items.name: Zight (formerly CloudApp)
items.difference: Mixes quick screenshots and GIFs with video recording.

items.name: Microsoft Clipchamp
items.what: Video editor with screen and camera recording
items.difference: More of an editor; suits teams in Microsoft 365.

items.name: Miro
items.starts_at: Free; Starter $8 per member/month billed annually
items.difference: Another async-collaboration tool, but on a shared canvas rather than video.

pros: Very quick to record and share: the link is ready as soon as you stop
Comments and emoji reactions sit right on the video
Built into Atlassian's Jira and Confluence
cons: Free plan limits screen recordings to 5 minutes and 25 videos per person
AI features cost extra on the Business + AI plan

faq.a: Yes, the Starter plan is free, with up to 25 videos per person and screen recordings up to 5 minutes.
